Questions and alerts the sender marked high urgency. They interrupt with a sound.
Questions and alerts the sender gave no urgency, or normal urgency. They make a sound.
Questions and alerts the sender marked low urgency. They make no sound.
Questions and alerts the sender marked very low urgency. They make no sound and stay minimized.
The notification that stays while transom holds its connection to your server, so questions arrive with the app closed.

No address was found for that name.

Android\'s notification settings have a channel for each urgency, where you choose how each one alerts.
Lets a notification\'s plain buttons, such as Open, work without unlocking. Chips and typed replies always need unlocking.
transom holds a connection to your server, so questions arrive with the app closed.
Questions arrive only while transom is open.
This phone wakes through Google\'s push service when a question arrives, so transom holds no connection to your server in the background.
The server can\'t be reached. Check your connection and try again.
